search_log: listed PFE (CIK 0000078003) 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages): 6671 filings; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2015-01 to 2026-08 (53, of which 48 carry an EX-99.1 earnings release; 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases; the 2016-02-16 8-K/A carries no usable product table and the original 2016-02-02 release was used)

parsed every release's product tables with scripts/extract.py; quarter row = first occurrence of the product row, year-to-date row = third occurrence (or second where sub-region tables are absent); checked by summing quarters to the printed twelve-month figure

line printed under several labels (BNT162b2 -> BNT162b2 alliance revenues and direct sales -> Comirnaty direct sales and alliance revenues -> Comirnaty) for the same vaccine; treated as one series, labels documented per row; Pfizer's line is direct sales plus alliance revenues (BioNTech), not product sales only.
